price: Flat-rate, no monthly fee. Online 2.9% + 30¢; in-person (Stripe Terminal) 2.7% + 5¢; international cards +1.5%; ACH is far cheaper (good for recurring and large invoices). No setup or monthly fees on standard accounts | $0 | flat-rate

Optional "Pay Monthly" plan lowers swipe/keyed rates. No Payments-specific monthly fee. Rates mid-2025 — reconfirm. | flat-rate
reputation_flag: Documented pattern of holds/freezes on large, legitimate transactions (reports into the tens of thousands of dollars) during opaque reviews, with uneven support to resolve them. A real cash-flow risk for big-ticket trades jobs — keep a backup processor.

price: In-person/QR 2.29% + $0.09; keyed 3.49% + $0.09; invoicing (card) 2.99% + $0.49, or via ACH 1% (cap $10); online 2.99% + $0.49. No monthly/setup fee on the POS app; first reader $29. Optional add-ons: Invoicing $14.99/mo, Payments Pro $30/mo, Recurring $10/mo. | flat-rate
reputation_flag: Long, well-documented history of freezing account balances for 21–180 days when it detects an unusual sales spike — the exact profile of a contractor landing a big job. Keep funds swept to a separate bank and a backup processor ready.
